AttentionState.description: Why one Ticket demands operator attention: the closed Attention Item classes from CONTEXT.md. The per-Ticket projection that raises them lands with the attention inbox (KAN-S11); the vocabulary is fixed here so the filter surface is complete first.

oneOf.description: A registered dependency or external blocker holds the work.
A settled run finished without its required submission.
The work waits on a human decision.
A review asks the operator in.
A schedule failed to activate or mint its occurrence.
The session observing the work disconnected.
A run passed its stall deadline.

BoardFilterOption.description: One selectable value of a reference axis: its identity and the label the operator knows it by.

id.description: The value the filter carries when selected.

description: The values each reference axis currently offers, as the query reads them: every Initiative, Project, Plan, Spec, Lane, and Execution Profile that exists, and the closed attention vocabulary. A client renders its filter surface from this alone.

lanes.description: Every Lane, by its Project and identity.

profiles.description: Every Execution Profile, by name: a profile's identity is its name, so the name is the whole option.

projects.description: Every Project, by code and name.

specs.description: Every Spec, by rendered number and name.
